scope: USA and Canada only. Festivals, fairs, shows, and competitions for dogs and cats, compiled for the Events & Festivals section of pawpartout.com. All dates, rules, and URLs were verified from official sources on 27 November 2026. Nothing was invented.
state_or_province_format: Two-letter codes for US states and Canadian provinces (e.g., NY, CA, ON, QC, AB).

events.name: Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show
events.dates_or_season: January 30 & February 1–2, 2027 (Canine Celebration on January 30; conformation show on February 1–2)
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Unentered dogs are not permitted at either venue (Javits Center or Madison Square Garden).
events.summary: America’s iconic benched dog show returns to New York City, with daytime breed judging at the Javits Center and evening groups and Best in Show at Madison Square Garden.

events.name: AKC National Championship presented by Royal Canin
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Only dogs being exhibited or participating in special attractions are allowed; service animals are permitted.
events.summary: This major American conformation championship brings thousands of top dogs to Orlando’s Orange County Convention Center, alongside owner-handled finals and other Championship Week events.

events.name: National Dog Show presented by Purina
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Spectators are not allowed to bring dogs.
events.summary: Hosted by the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this annual all-breed showcase in the Philadelphia area is taped for NBC’s Thanksgiving broadcast and is open to the public on show weekend.

events.name: CFA International Cat Show & Expo
events.summary: The Cat Fanciers’ Association’s flagship international show and expo returns to the New Jersey Expo Center in Edison, featuring hundreds of pedigreed and household cats in championship judging.

events.name: Club Félin de Montréal Cat Show
events.summary: This Canadian Cat Association championship show, hosted by Club Félin de Montréal at College Letendre in Laval, is one of Quebec’s upcoming pedigreed and household-pet cat shows.

events.name: Canadian Cat Fanciers' Club Show
events.summary: The Canadian Cat Fanciers’ Club will host a CCA-AFC cat show in Kingston, Ontario, listed on the Canadian Cat Association’s official upcoming-show calendar for February 2027.

events.name: Spring Canadian Pet Expo
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Well-behaved, vaccinated dogs on a short non-retractable leash welcome — confirm Spring 2027 requirements on the official site.
events.summary: Canada’s large spring public pet expo returns to Mississauga’s International Centre over Easter weekend, with shopping, entertainment, a dog show, and other family-friendly attractions.

events.name: World of Pets Expo
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Well-socialized pets on a leash are permitted; dogs are not allowed in the cat event area.
events.summary: This long-running East Coast family pet expo fills the Maryland State Fairgrounds with exhibitors, education, entertainment, and adoption opportunities for pet lovers and well-socialized leashed pets.

events.name: Global Pet Expo
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Trade only — not open to the public. Buyer and manufacturer representative attendees may not bring animals; service animals are welcome.
events.summary: Presented by APPA and PIDA, this premier pet-industry trade show at Orlando’s Orange County Convention Center is open to qualified professionals only, not the general public.

events.name: SUPERZOO
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Attendees cannot bring pets. Only animals used in demos, education sessions, exhibitor booths, and service animals are permitted.
events.summary: World Pet Association’s major trade show returns to the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas, with a professional exhibit floor, education sessions, and restricted animal access.

events.name: Edmonton Pet Expo
events.summary: This public Alberta pet expo at the Edmonton EXPO Centre features entertainment such as SuperDogs and a cat-club showcase; organizers require visitors to leave their own pets at home.

events.name: Ottawa Pet Expo
events.summary: Eastern Ontario’s public pet expo returns to Ottawa’s COHERE Centre with agility and lure courses, a TICA cat show, grooming championships, and more than 200 Canadian vendors.

events.name: Paws in the Park Presented by Amazon
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Dogs welcome — organizers invite guests to bring their dog.
events.summary: Toronto Humane Society’s annual community celebration of pets returns on August 14, 2027, inviting families and dogs for a day of activities, vendors, and fundraising.

events.name: Dog Days of Glendale
events.summary: This volunteer-run annual community festival in Glendale, Arizona, brings together dog lovers, local businesses, and rescue groups for demonstrations, vendors, and adoption outreach.

events.name: Frankenmuth Dog Bowl
events.summary: The 20th anniversary of this Olympic-style dog festival at Frankenmuth’s River Place Shops features dock and disc competitions, races, a vendor marketplace, and balloon events over Memorial Day weekend.

events.name: Bark in the Park — Tampa
events.dates_or_season: February 6, 2027 (a second official walk is April 17, 2027, in St. Petersburg)
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Family and pet-friendly community walk; organizers invite guests to leash up and join.
events.summary: The Humane Society of Tampa Bay’s family-friendly fundraising walk returns to Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, with a second official walk on April 17, 2027, at Albert Whitted Park in St. Petersburg.

events.name: So Cal Corgi Nation Christmas Parade
events.visitor_pets_allowed: Marching with the Corgi Nation contingent requires a participant flag and a corgi; the parade is free to watch.
events.summary: So Cal Corgi Nation’s festive corgi contingent returns to Long Beach’s Belmont Shore Christmas Parade, with costumed corgis marching the route and free public viewing along Second Street.

events.name: AKC National Agility Championship
events.summary: AKC’s national agility championship brings top titled agility dogs to Expo Square in Tulsa for four days of championship-level competition at the Built Ford Tough Livestock Complex.

events.name: USDAA Cynosport World Games (West)
events.summary: USDAA will stage a western edition of the Cynosport World Games at Tucson’s Kino Sports Complex, with qualified competitors able to attend this event, the eastern event, or both.

events.name: AKC Agility Invitational
events.summary: Held during AKC National Championship week in Orlando, this invitational agility competition welcomes top dogs by breed to the Orange County Convention Center.

events.name: Westminster Masters Agility Championship
events.summary: The 14th annual Masters Agility Championship is part of Westminster Week at the Javits Center, with daytime preliminaries and evening finals on Canine Celebration Saturday.

events.name: NAFA CanAm
events.summary: The North American Flyball Association’s CanAm championship is scheduled for October 8–10, 2027, in the West Pavilion at the Indiana State Fairgrounds, according to official NAFA board highlights.
